text_block_list.text: After the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How'd you let it slip from your reach?!
First place
should've been easy for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You are seriously the strongest! And
that's why I
never let myself lose either...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's what kept me going, giving it my
best up
till now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you lose?! You were always just
out of my
reach...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Quit your crying!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Accept it. My results and your own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But don't you think for a second that this
is it for
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep racing, just like any
other racer
who's come this far in the
Classics would.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if I stumble, I'll get back on my
feet and
fight. Just like you would.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So don't you dare look down on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's how you have to say it with her.
choice_data_list: Was it really okay to say it like ...
Were you really okay saying it lik...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to be anyone's idol. I just
want to be
known as a relentless racer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone that I'm going to get
stronger
and faster—enough to leave
today's version of
myself in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So there's no time for taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it's been quite the
year. Challenging the Classic Triple
Crown, learning
everyone's strengths,
and forging my own...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the final victory slipped
through my
fingers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Unbelievable. There's never a dull
moment in
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's bring the pain next year. I'm
prepared to
crawl my way out from the
depths of hell if that's
what it takes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You choose.
choice_data_list: What should we do about our target...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy as long as you pick
somewhere I can
get stronger. In the
least amount of time.

Next year is her senior year. Maybe
competing
with the most elite racers
would be a good
experience for her.

The prestigious shield award awaits in
the spring Tenno Sho. But first, I'd like
to see how the Hanshin Daishoten goes,
as it's often considered
a preliminary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sure.
choice_data_list: What do you think of the Hanshin D...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just let me run more and more.
